# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good intent, criticise code and not people. Harassment, insults and
discrimination of any kind are not tolerated in issues, pull requests, discussions or any other project space.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainer through the contact details on the
[VectoDE GitHub profile](https://github.com/VectoDE). Reports are treated confidentially.

## Enforcement

The maintainer decides on consequences, from a warning to a permanent ban, following the enforcement
guidelines of the Contributor Covenant.
